name: Processor B
topology_description: Nine-qubit, 12-edge participant-designed connected graph: an eight-edge chain plus chords [3,5], [6,8], [0,4], and [2,6]. It contains two local triangles (3-4-5 and 6-7-8), separated from Processor A's branching shape, so the required workload can test whether transpilation benefits from local three-node connectivity.
source: participant-designed topology guided by the organizer's nine-qubit requirement; research simulation
note: Participant-defined research model. This graph is intentionally designed for the experiment and is not represented as an organizer-issued edge list or calibrated hardware.
